display_name: Precision-style strong club, the project's own rule bidder

notes: Bid by bridge_harness/rule_bidder.py from configs/rule-systems/precision-r4.json. Every call the tables define has an exact meaning (bidder.describe).
Strong artificial 1C, limited five-card majors, 1D catch-all, 1NT range and the rest as in the settings, which are also the descriptor.

Where the tables stop, the general procedure counts points and is helped by a trick estimate fitted to double-dummy results (the file the settings name): it may bid on over the other side's contract with a known fit or a five-card suit, and doubles from the three level, on expected score. A game bid over the other side's bid promises no extra strength.
The earlier system without the estimate (rules r3, identity 7ee5d918af80) is configs/rule-systems/precision.json; it is unchanged and still built by the same code.
